title: Line Startup Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: Route the production line clearance, setup, and controlled release, verify readiness, record requirement-level results, contain exceptions, authorize status, and preserve accountable closeout.
description: An operational line startup inspection checklist form for controlling a line, product, work order, and startup configuration from assignment through evidence-based inspection, exception containment, disposition, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when a line lead or startup verifier must inspect a line, product, work order, and startup configuration against the work order, setup instruction, approved recipe or program, and site safety procedure and provide a traceable basis to hold or authorize the line to begin controlled production.

sections.title: Line Startup inspection assignment
sections.guidance: Identify the exact item, reference set, inspection owner, and routing deadline.

blocks.label: Line, Product, Work Order, And Startup Configuration identity
Inspection scope, reason, boundaries, and required outcome

sections.title: Acceptance basis and inspection readiness
sections.guidance: Confirm the current work order, setup instruction, approved recipe or program, and site safety procedure and the evidence needed to inspect.

blocks.label: Pre-inspection readiness checkpoints
items: Previous product, material, labels, documents, and waste are cleared from the line
Work order, product, revision, recipe, program, and setup instruction agree
Required cleaning, sanitation, maintenance, and changeover records are complete
Materials, components, labels, and packaging match the job and status
Tooling, fixtures, settings, sensors, and inspection devices are identified
Machine guards, interlocks, emergency stops, and required protective controls were checked under site procedure
Energy isolation is removed only by authorized personnel under the site-specific procedure
Utilities, environment, temperature, pressure, or air supply are within startup limits

blocks.label: Available evidence package
items: Previous-job line-clearance and material reconciliation record
Current work order, setup instruction, recipe, and program revision
Cleaning, sanitation, maintenance, and changeover completion
Material, component, label, and packaging identity verification
Tooling, fixture, sensor, and inspection-device setup record
Site-procedure safety-control and equipment-readiness verification
First-piece, trial-run, parameter, and defect results
Startup release, restriction, first accepted unit, and crew handoff

sections.title: Line Startup inspection execution
sections.guidance: Record actual observations and results against identifiable requirements.

blocks.label: Startup settings and first-run verification
blocks.guidance: Record actual values where the requirement is variable; do not use pass-only entries when evidence is available.

blocks.label: Execution and traceability controls
items: Tooling, fixtures, settings, sensors, and inspection devices are identified
Machine guards, interlocks, emergency stops, and required protective controls were checked under site procedure
Energy isolation is removed only by authorized personnel under the site-specific procedure
Utilities, environment, temperature, pressure, or air supply are within startup limits
First-piece or trial-run samples meet specified characteristics
Scrap, rejects, and startup output remain segregated until release
Deviation, alarm, unresolved maintenance, or safety concern prevents startup
Released settings, first accepted unit, and next check are handed off to the crew

blocks.label: Inspection observations, evidence references, sample rationale, and limitations

sections.title: Findings, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every exception visible with immediate control, ownership, and a disposition route.

blocks.label: Line Startup exceptions requiring action
items: Prior product, material, label, document, or waste remains on the line
Work order, product, recipe, program, or setup revision mismatch
Cleaning, maintenance, safety control, or utility readiness incomplete
Material, tooling, label, or measurement device status mismatch
Parameter outside startup limit or independent check missing
First-piece, trial-run, function, or workmanship result fails
Alarm, leak, damage, unusual condition, or unresolved maintenance issue
Startup proceeds without documented authority or crew handoff
blocks.guidance: Select every applicable exception and preserve the original observation.

blocks.label: Exception, containment, ownership, and disposition log
Exception facts, affected scope, containment boundary, and unresolved risk

sections.title: Inspection decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Document the evidence-based decision to hold or authorize the line to begin controlled production.

blocks.label: Decision boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records inspection evidence and routing. Use qualified personnel and the applicable work order, setup instruction, approved recipe or program, and site safety procedure for technical acceptance, safety, customer, or regulatory decisions.

blocks.label: Acceptance rationale, conditions, rejected evidence, and scope of authorization

fields.label: Line Lead Or Startup Verifier / date
Production, Maintenance, Safety, Or Quality Release Owner / date

sections.title: Follow-up, handoff, and inspection closeout
sections.guidance: Close only when open work, evidence ownership, limitations, and receiving handoff are explicit.

blocks.label: Open action and accountable handoff register
Final decision basis, residual limitations, next action, and receiving handoff

fields.label: Outcome rationale and accountable handoff summary

blocks.label: Accountable review and closeout

fields.label: Production, Maintenance, Safety, Or Quality Release Owner / date

blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not replace required technical or regulatory approval.
